turns.text: Hi, can you tell me when my order will arrive? It is still being made, I think.
Hello, I can help you check that. Please send me your order number (it starts with SC- followed by four digits) and the email address the order was placed with.
The order is SC-3188 and the email is helen.crowe@example.com. It ships to Berlin.

Thank you, Helen. Your order SC-3188 (Blue Stair, 30x40 cm) is currently in production. Each print is made to order in 3 to 5 working days. Once it ships, the tracking link will be on the order. I do not have a delivery date to give you yet, so please check the order again after production finishes. Is there anything else I can help with?

rule.ro: Fiecare print este realizat la comandă în 3–5 zile lucrătoare.
rule.en: Each print is made to order in 3 to 5 working days.
